services.name: Police emergency
services.summary: Call the police if someone is in danger, a crime is happening, or there is a serious accident.
steps: Stay safe and move away from danger if you can.
Call 192.
Say what happened, where you are, and if anyone is hurt.
Stay on the line until they tell you to hang up.

services.name: Fire emergency
services.summary: Call the fire service for a fire or when someone is trapped.
steps: Get everyone out of the building.
Call 193.
Say what is burning and the exact place.
Do not go back inside.

services.name: Ambulance
services.summary: Call an ambulance for a medical emergency: serious injury, not breathing, chest pain, heavy bleeding, or birth complications.
steps: Call 194.
Say where you are and what happened.
Follow the instructions given on the phone.
If you cannot get through, go to the nearest hospital or health centre.
services.provider: Ministry of Health and Medical Services

services.name: Disaster and weather warnings
services.summary: Information on king tides, storms, drought and disaster preparedness. Listen to local radio for official warnings.
steps: Listen to Radio Kiribati and official announcements.
Know your nearest higher ground or safe building.
Keep drinking water, food, a torch and important documents ready.
Follow instructions from your island council and officials.
services.provider: National Disaster Management Office (Office of Te Beretitenti)
services.sourceName: National Disaster Management Office (to be confirmed)

services.name: Renew a driver's licence
services.location: Driver licensing office (confirm the current office before visiting)
services.summary: Renew your driver's licence before it expires so you can keep driving legally.
steps: Check the expiry date on your current licence.
Go to the licensing office with your current licence and photo ID.
Fill in the renewal form.
Pay the renewal fee and keep your receipt.
Have your photo taken if asked, then collect your new licence.
services.fees: Not yet confirmed – ask the licensing office
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with the licensing office

services.name: Get a new driver's licence
services.location: Driver licensing office (confirm the current office before visiting)
services.summary: Apply for your first driver's licence or learner's permit for a car or motorbike.
steps: Ask the licensing office which test you need (written and/or driving).
Bring your ID and the application form.
Pass the required test.
Pay the fee and collect your licence.
services.fees: Not yet confirmed – ask the licensing office
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with the licensing office

services.name: Apply for or renew a passport
services.summary: Apply for a new Kiribati passport or renew an expired one. Apply early – it can take time.
steps: Get the passport application form from the immigration office.
Collect your documents (see requirements).
Submit the form and documents in person.
Pay the fee and keep your receipt.
Collect your passport when you are told it is ready.
services.fees: Not yet confirmed – ask the immigration office
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with Kiribati Immigration

services.name: Get a birth certificate
services.summary: Register a birth or get a copy of a birth certificate. Often needed for school, passports and jobs.
steps: Go to the civil registration office.
Give the full name, date and place of birth, and parents' names.
Pay the fee.
Collect the certificate.
requirements: Details of the person (name, date and place of birth)
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with Civil Registration

services.name: Kiribati Provident Fund (KPF) – check or claim savings
services.summary: Check your retirement savings balance, update your details, or ask about withdrawals.
steps: Bring your ID and KPF member number if you have it.
Visit the KPF office or contact them.
Ask for a statement or the withdrawal requirements.

services.name: Register a business
services.summary: Register a business name or company and get a business licence.
steps: Choose a business name.
Visit the business registry with your ID.
Fill in the registration form.
Pay the registration and licence fees.
Check with the island council if you also need a local licence.

services.name: Tungaru Central Hospital
services.summary: The main national hospital. Emergency, outpatient, maternity and specialist services.
steps: For emergencies go straight to the emergency department or call 194.
For non-urgent care, go to outpatients early in the day.
Bring any medical records or medicines you are taking.
requirements: Any medical records or referral letter
services.provider: Ministry of Health and Medical Services
services.sourceName: Ministry of Health and Medical Services (to be confirmed)

services.name: Find a health clinic or health centre
services.location: Clinics and health centres in villages across Kiribati
services.summary: Local health centres and clinics provide check-ups, child vaccinations, family planning and basic treatment. Outer islands usually have a health centre or dispensary.
steps: Ask your village or island council where the nearest clinic is.
Go during opening hours, or call 194 in an emergency.
Bring your child's health book for vaccinations.
services.provider: Ministry of Health and Medical Services
services.sourceName: Ministry of Health and Medical Services (to be confirmed)

services.name: Hospital on Kiritimati (London)
services.summary: Main hospital for Kiritimati (Christmas Island) and the Line Islands.
steps: In an emergency, go straight to the hospital.
Bring any medical records you have.
services.provider: Ministry of Health and Medical Services

services.name: Get medicine (pharmacy)
services.summary: Prescription medicines are usually given at the hospital pharmacy. Some private pharmacies also sell medicines.
steps: Get a prescription from a doctor or nurse.
Take the prescription to the hospital pharmacy or a pharmacy.
Ask how and when to take the medicine.

services.name: Mental health and counselling support
services.location: Ask at the hospital or your health centre
services.summary: Help for stress, depression, anxiety, alcohol or drug problems, and thoughts of self-harm. If someone is in immediate danger, call 194 or 192.
steps: If someone is in danger now, call 194 (ambulance) or 192 (police).
Talk to a nurse or doctor at your health centre or the hospital.
Ask to be referred to mental health services.
services.provider: Ministry of Health and Medical Services

services.name: Find a job / register as a job seeker
services.location: Ministry of Employment and Human Resources (confirm location)
services.summary: Register as a job seeker and hear about local job vacancies. Also check notice boards, radio and newspapers for vacancies.
steps: Prepare a short CV with your skills, education and work experience.
Register with the employment office.
Check vacancy notices regularly.
Apply before the closing date with copies of your certificates.
services.provider: Ministry of Employment and Human Resources

services.name: Work in Australia (PALM scheme)
services.location: Apply through the Kiribati labour mobility office
services.summary: The Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme offers seasonal and longer-term jobs in Australia. Apply only through official channels – never pay an agent to get you a place.
steps: Contact the Kiribati labour mobility office (Ministry of Employment and Human Resources).
Register in the work-ready pool and complete any checks.
Wait to be selected by an employer.
Prepare passport, medical and police clearance when asked.
services.fees: Registration should be free. Beware of scams asking for money.
services.provider: Ministry of Employment and Human Resources / Australian Government

services.name: Work in New Zealand (RSE scheme)
services.location: Apply through the Kiribati labour mobility office
services.summary: The Recognised Seasonal Employer (RSE) scheme offers seasonal horticulture and viticulture work in New Zealand.
steps: Contact the Kiribati labour mobility office.
Register and complete the selection process.
Prepare passport, medical and police clearance when asked.
services.fees: Beware of scams asking for money.
services.provider: Ministry of Employment and Human Resources / New Zealand Government

services.name: Seafarer training and jobs at sea
services.summary: Training for work as a seafarer on international ships.
steps: Ask the Marine Training Centre about the next intake.
Meet the entry and medical requirements.
Complete the training to qualify for ship work.
requirements: Check entry requirements with the centre

services.name: Apply for a scholarship
services.summary: Government and donor scholarships for study in Kiribati and overseas. Watch for announcements and closing dates each year.
steps: Check which scholarships are open and their closing dates.
Read the eligibility rules.
Collect your certificates, transcripts and ID.
Submit your application before the closing date.
services.sourceName: Australia Awards (DFAT) – plus local scholarships office (to be confirmed)

services.name: University of the South Pacific – Kiribati Campus
services.summary: University courses and foundation studies, on campus and online.
steps: Check the courses and enrolment dates.
Apply online or at the campus.
Pay fees or arrange sponsorship.

services.name: Kiribati Institute of Technology (KIT)
services.summary: Trade and vocational courses such as carpentry, plumbing, electrical, automotive, hospitality and business.
steps: Check the courses and intake dates.
Apply with your school certificates.
Attend any interview or test.

services.name: Enrol a child in school
services.summary: How to enrol your child in primary or junior secondary school.
steps: Visit the nearest school before the school year starts.
Bring the child's birth certificate.
Fill in the enrolment form.
requirements: Health or immunisation book (may be asked)
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with Ministry of Education

services.name: Domestic flights (Air Kiribati)
services.summary: Flights between Tarawa and the outer islands. Book early and check baggage limits.
steps: Contact Air Kiribati or a travel agent for the schedule.
Book and pay for your ticket.
Arrive early at the airport with your ID and ticket.
services.fees: Varies by route – ask Air Kiribati
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with Air Kiribati

services.name: International flights
services.summary: International flights connect Kiribati with Fiji, Nauru, Hawaii and other destinations. Routes change often – check with airlines or a travel agent.
steps: Check current routes with a travel agent or airline.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least 6 months.
Check visa requirements for your destination.

services.name: Ships to the outer islands
services.summary: Passenger and cargo ships travel between Tarawa and the outer islands. Schedules change – check with the shipping company before you travel.
steps: Ask the shipping office or listen to radio announcements for the next sailing.
Book your passage and cargo.
Arrive at the port early with your ticket.
services.fees: Varies by island – ask the shipping company
services.provider: Kiribati Shipping Services Ltd and private operators
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with shipping operators

services.name: Buses in South Tarawa
services.summary: Minibuses run along the main road between Betio and Bonriki. Wave to stop a bus and pay the driver.
steps: Wait by the main road and wave to stop a bus.
Tell the driver where you are going.
Pay the fare when you get off.

services.name: Find a mechanic
services.summary: Car, motorbike and outboard engine repairs. Ask neighbours for recommendations and agree on the price before work starts.
steps: Ask for recommendations from friends or neighbours.
Describe the problem and ask for a quote.
Agree on price and time before work starts.
services.sourceName: Community listing – businesses can ask to be listed

services.name: Electricity and water (PUB)
services.summary: New connections, power cards/tokens, faults and bills for electricity and water in South Tarawa.
steps: For a fault or outage, contact PUB.
For a new connection, visit the PUB office with your ID and land details.
Buy power credit at PUB or authorised sellers.

services.name: Open a bank account
services.location: Bank branches in South Tarawa and Kiritimati
services.summary: Open a savings or transaction account. Needed to receive wages, including from overseas work schemes.
steps: Choose a bank.
Visit a branch with your ID and proof of address.
Fill in the forms and make your first deposit.
requirements: Proof of address or letter (may be asked)
services.provider: ANZ Bank (Kiribati), Development Bank of Kiribati and others

services.name: Send or receive money from overseas
services.summary: Receive money from family or workers overseas through a bank or money transfer agent. Compare fees.
steps: Ask the sender to use a bank transfer or a money transfer service.
Bring your ID and the reference number to collect.
Compare fees and exchange rates.

services.name: Check prices before you buy
services.summary: Prices for fuel, rice, flour, sugar and other goods change often and differ by island. Ask the store, and report unusual price rises.
steps: Compare prices at two or three stores if you can.
Ask for a receipt.
Report price problems to the consumer protection office (confirm contact).

services.name: Government fees (licences, passports, certificates)
services.summary: Official fees for government services. We only list a fee once it has been confirmed with the office – always ask for a receipt.
steps: Find the service you need using search.
Confirm the fee with the office before paying.
Always get an official receipt.

services.name: Help for family and domestic violence
services.location: Police, health centres and support services
services.summary: If you or someone you know is being hurt at home, help is available. In immediate danger, call the police on 192.
steps: If you are in danger now, call 192 (police).
Go to a safe place – a trusted family member, church or neighbour.
Get medical care at a health centre or the hospital.
Ask the police or health workers about counselling and support services.
services.provider: Kiribati Police Service and support services
services.sourceName: To be confirmed with support services

services.name: Island councils
services.summary: Island and town councils handle local matters such as markets, local licences, waste collection and community notices.
steps: Visit or call your council office.
Ask about local licences, community projects or notices.
services.provider: Island and town councils (e.g. BTC, TUC)

services.name: Community notices and events
services.summary: Church events, sports, meetings and public announcements. Send us a notice to be listed here.
steps: Use 'Suggest a service' to send us your notice.
Include the date, place and a contact person.
